global.empty: There are no cookies in the browser

auto.title: Automatic run
auto.cleanQuestion: What should the timer clean on each cycle?

targets.trackersDesc: Removes known trackers from every site.
targets.blacklistDesc: Removes cookies from the sites on your blacklist.
targets.strictDesc: Also removes cookies from every other site.

rules.whitelistExact: This exact domain is never cleaned
rules.whitelistWildcard: Never cleaned, including all its subdomains
rules.blacklistWildcard: Cleaned on every cycle, including all its subdomains

status.guaranteeTitle: No Clean button, the timer, the blacklist or strict mode ever deletes locked cookies or cookies from whitelisted sites. They are only deleted if you delete them yourself, one by one.

editor.name: Name
editor.rawHint: Exact value stored in the browser.
editor.sizeLimit: Chrome does not store cookies whose name and value exceed {{max}} bytes
editor.decodedHint: JWT payload · read-only. Switch to “{{raw}}” to edit the value.
editor.domainHint: With a leading dot, subdomains receive it too, for example:
editor.renameNotice: Changing the name, domain or path creates a new cookie and deletes the old one.
editor.sessionNotice: The browser deletes it when all its windows are closed.
editor.sameSiteLax: Sent when arriving at the site from a link, not on requests from other sites.
editor.sameSiteStrict: Only sent on requests from the site itself.
editor.whitelistedNotice: This cookie is already protected, locked or not.
editor.sameSiteUnspecified: Not set: the browser treats it as Lax.

errors.nameInvalid: The name can’t contain spaces, ; , = or control characters
errors.hostPrefix: A __Host- cookie must be Secure, with path / and no leading dot in the domain
errors.valueInvalid: The value can’t contain ; or line breaks
errors.tooLarge: Name and value exceed {{maxBytes}} bytes: Chrome won’t save it
errors.domainInvalid: Only letters, digits, . and -, with an optional leading dot
errors.expired: That date has passed: Chrome would delete it on save
errors.tooFar: Chrome doesn’t allow expirations more than {{maxDays}} days away

confirm.deleteLockedMessage: Only this cookie will be deleted, and the site may sign you out.

protects.title: What ReSession protects
protects.guaranteeText: No ReSession action that deletes in bulk ever touches a protected cookie, by any path.
protects.conditions: A cookie is protected if it meets either of these two conditions:
protects.whitelisted: Its site is on your whitelist, locked or not.

scope.cleanButtons: Every “Clean” button: folders, selection and “Clean all”
scope.conflict: If a site is on both the whitelist and the blacklist, the whitelist wins.

protects.manual: Protected items are only deleted if you delete them yourself, one cookie at a time, with the trash button or from the editor. ReSession will ask you to confirm.
protects.counts: After each cleaning you will see the numbers:

buttons.title: What each button does
buttons.deleteDesc: Deletes a single cookie or key, the one you choose.
buttons.cleanDesc: Deletes everything that is not protected in a folder, the selection or the whole browser.
buttons.emptyDesc: Deletes all of the tab's localStorage or sessionStorage. Storage has no lock: you are always asked to confirm.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.close: Close the editor, the menu or this help
